item.title: 77 Wild Things Employers And Management Did That Made Workers Nope Out
item.description: Not every workplace can be as positively unhinged and quirky as Dunder Mifflin. In some offices, you might get reprimanded for talking to the office fish. item.title: Former CIA Case Officer Finally Reveals His Career To Family And Gives The Public A Rare Glimpse Into His World

item.title: 75 Times Companies Messed Up Custom Products In The Most Hilarious Way Possible (New Pics)
item.description: The fact that everyone makes mistakes shouldn’t be an excuse for sloppy work. Companies that do custom products should know the importance of double-checking everything and not cutting corners! ‘PeanutButterIsOneWord’ is an online group where customers share the most hilarious and painful custom product fails they’ve ever witnessed.
